check: verify the integration-matrix entry's claim that no method in this repository can add Tectonic, C2ME or the pack
theClaim: No method exists within this repository: the smoke classpath loads three jars, so a profile flag cannot add Tectonic, C2ME or the pack. It requires a real instance with those mods installed.

whatTheRunActuallyLoaded.nonJar: mixinextras, java and minecraft entries, which are not mod jars
whatTheRunActuallyLoaded.verdict: The 39 fabric entries all come from the single fabric-api jar, so the classpath carries three mod jars: fabric-api, this mod, and the smoke harness. The entry's figure is accurate rather than approximate.

whatProfileActuallyControls.line12: read from the gradle property, defaulting to vanilla
whatProfileActuallyControls.line137: passed as a system property to the server smoke JVM
whatProfileActuallyControls.line328: passed the same way to a second task
whatProfileActuallyControls.directoryUse: lines 18 and 135 place the run directory at build/run/serverSmoke/<profile>/<runId>, and lines 177 and 178 write the profile name into the two marker files
whatProfileActuallyControls.whatItNeverDoes: It never appears in a classpath expression. The classpath is assembled from the source sets at lines 4, 5, 9 and 10, so no value of this property can add a jar.

whyTheClaimHolds: Changing the profile changes where the run happens and what string the mod sees, not what it loads. A run labelled tectonic would still load the same three jars, which is precisely what the entry says.
theSecondHalfIsAlsoRight: Tectonic, C2ME and the pack have to be installed in a real instance, because that is the only way they enter a classpath here.
